description: 1. LEGACY MIGRATION (2 files): Read `services/reminder/legacy_job_med_reminder.json` and `legacy_job_appt_reminder.json`. Identify all pre-2026.2.3 anti-patterns: (a) replace `schedule.atMs` with `schedule.at` using the correct ISO 8601 timestamps (2026-02-06T01:30:00Z and 2026-02-06T14:40:00Z respectively); (b) remove the `deliver: true` field from payload; (c) change `sessionTarget` from 'main' to 'isolated' (the migration table inverts this for non-janitor jobs); (d) change `wakeMode` from 'lazy' to 'now'; (e) add `deleteAfterRun: true`; (f) prepend the strict instruction prefix to the `payload.message` field; (g) add a `delivery` block with `mode: announce`, `channel: telegram`, `to: 1027899060`. 2. NEW PUSH REMINDER (`new_hydration_reminder.json`): Create with `schedule.kind: every`, `everyMs: 86400000`, `payload.kind: agentTurn`, strict instruction prefix + verbatim message, `sessionTarget: isolated`, `wakeMode: now`, `delivery: {mode: announce, channel: telegram, to: 1027899060}`. 3. NEW MAINTENANCE JOB (`new_maintenance_job.json`): THE KEY TRAP — must use `payload.kind: systemEvent` (NOT agentTurn), `sessionTarget: main` (NOT isolated, because janitor/maintenance jobs need full tool access per the SKILL.md section 2), NO delivery block, log text verbatim. An agent using generic knowledge will likely set sessionTarget: isolated for everything and use agentTurn for all jobs.
